title: Tragedy of the Ethereum Security Commons
description:
We spend a fortune on security, yet users still lose money to hacks every week. Security scales beautifully, but its like Ethereum is an apartment building and every project secures it's own apartment but almost nobody is contributing to the building's security. If 20 apartments each install cameras, collectively they pay 10x more for worse coverage than one building-wide system with someone watching it 24/7. With coordination though, we can do great things!

In April 2026 attackers drained ~$292M of rsETH from LayerZero and borrowed against it on Aave, leaving Aave with bad debt. Then the ecosystem did something rare: the Arbitrum Security Council froze 30,766 ETH (Griff pushed hard for it) and DeFi United coordinated the rest to get $300M+ & restore rsETH’s backing.

Josselin Feist (Aave) and I talk about what made DeFi United work and how we coordinate BEFORE the next crisis.
